name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food Truck Kitchen Orders
promotionalText: Take orders ahead, protect your kitchen from excess orders and keep trading when the signal is lost. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team uses to run the business.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, then mark it ready and collected.

DON'T PROMISE A TIME THAT CAN'T BE MET
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can't choose it, so the order queue matches what the kitchen can handle.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE COUNTER
Add walk-in orders on the same screen as orders placed ahead, so the kitchen works from one queue.

ONE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what needs making now, what's next and what's already ready, with an alert when an order needs to start cooking.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a kitchen receipt printer via Bluetooth or via your local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP TRADING WHEN THE SIGNAL IS LOST
Switch on offline order protection and, if the connection drops, ordering ahead is paused so nobody places an order you can't see. Orders you take on the device are kept and synced when you're back online.

BUILT FOR THE VAN
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on while trading, get notified when an order needs confirming, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN YOUR WEEK
Set up your events and locations just once and take orders for each one.

HatchGrab is for food truck operators and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to log in.
